title: dipsacus fullonum var. divaricatus
intro: Dipsacus fullonum var. divaricatus, commonly known as teasel, is a plant species in the honeysuckle family. It is used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of teasel include stimulating the lymphatic system, promoting blood circulation, and acting as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of teasel include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
